description.zh: 模拟 Codex 长期记忆的完整生命周期：Session 启动触发后台管道 → Phase1 per-rollout LLM 提取（stage_one_system.md 569行）→ SQLite stage1_outputs 持久化 → Phase2 全局整合 SubAgent（consolidation.md 835行）→ read_path.md 每轮注入 → <oai-mem-citation> 引用追踪 → usage_count 反馈选择。
description.en: Simulate Codex long-term memory full lifecycle: session start triggers pipeline → Phase1 per-rollout LLM extraction (stage_one_system.md 569 lines) → SQLite stage1_outputs persistence → Phase2 global consolidation SubAgent (consolidation.md 835 lines) → read_path.md per-turn injection → <oai-mem-citation> citation tracking → usage_count feedback selection.

annotation.zh: session.rs:836 — start_memories_startup_task() 是整个长期记忆系统的唯一入口。后台异步执行，按顺序：prune 清理 → Phase1 提取 → Phase2 整合。Feature::MemoryTool (key='memories') 和 Feature::Sqlite 必须都启用。
annotation.en: session.rs:836 — start_memories_startup_task() is the sole entry to the entire long-term memory system. Runs async in background, in order: prune cleanup → Phase1 extraction → Phase2 consolidation. Feature::MemoryTool and Feature::Sqlite must both be enabled.

annotation.zh: claim_startup_jobs() 通过 BEGIN IMMEDIATE 事务安全争抢。6小时闲置条件防止干扰正在进行的会话。ownership_token 是 UUID v4，持有者才能标记 job 完成。
annotation.en: claim_startup_jobs() safely claims via BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions. 6-hour idle condition prevents interference with active sessions. ownership_token is UUID v4 — only holder can mark job complete.

annotation.zh: Phase1 LLM 调用使用结构化输出 JSON schema，强制模型输出 {raw_memory, rollout_summary, rollout_slug}。系统提示是 stage_one_system.md（569行），包含 Memory Writing Agent 规范、高信号记忆定义、NO-OP 规则。
annotation.en: Phase1 LLM call uses structured output JSON schema, forcing model to output {raw_memory, rollout_summary, rollout_slug}. System prompt is stage_one_system.md (569 lines) with Memory Writing Agent spec, high-signal memory definition, NO-OP rules.

annotation.zh: Phase1 调用无工具（tools: vec![]），是纯粹的文本分析。结构化输出 schema 防止模型输出格式错误。NO-OP 逻辑：若模型判断 rollout 无值得保存的内容，返回空字段，标记 SucceededNoOutput 而非失败。
annotation.en: Phase1 call has no tools (tools: vec![]), pure text analysis. Structured output schema prevents malformed output. NO-OP logic: if model judges rollout has nothing worth saving, returns empty fields, marked as SucceededNoOutput not failure.

annotation.zh: 持久化是原子的：jobs 更新 + stage1_outputs upsert + Phase2 enqueue 在同一个事务中。enqueue_global_consolidation 自动推进 input_watermark，保证下次 Phase2 能感知到变化。
annotation.en: Persistence is atomic: jobs update + stage1_outputs upsert + Phase2 enqueue in same transaction. enqueue_global_consolidation advances input_watermark automatically, ensuring next Phase2 detects the change.

annotation.zh: Phase2 是全系统单例 (job_key='global')。get_phase2_input_selection 计算完整的增量 diff：selected（当前选中）、retained（与上次相同）、removed（被删除）。这个 diff 会传给 consolidation agent。
annotation.en: Phase2 is system-wide singleton (job_key='global'). get_phase2_input_selection computes full incremental diff: selected (current), retained (same as last run), removed (deleted). This diff is passed to the consolidation agent.

annotation.zh: Phase2 先同步 FS 再 spawn agent，确保 agent 启动时已有最新的 raw_memories.md 和 rollout_summaries/。consolidation.md 的 INCREMENTAL UPDATE 模式让 agent 只处理 diff 部分，而非重新整合全部历史。
annotation.en: Phase2 syncs FS before spawning agent, so agent starts with latest raw_memories.md and rollout_summaries/. consolidation.md INCREMENTAL UPDATE mode makes agent only process diff, not re-consolidate entire history.

annotation.zh: 注入是 per-turn 的，每次采样前重新构建 developer instructions。read_path.md（129行）规定了 Quick Memory Pass 协议（≤4-6 步），防止 agent 过度扫描记忆文件。memory_summary.md 内容直接嵌入，不需要 agent 打开文件。
annotation.en: Injection is per-turn, rebuilt before each sampling. read_path.md (129 lines) defines Quick Memory Pass protocol (≤4-6 steps), preventing agent from over-scanning memory files. memory_summary.md content is embedded inline, no file open needed.

steps.content:
根据记忆，认证模块在 3 月份重构时将 OAuth 回调路径从 /auth/callback 改为 /api/auth/callback，且密码哈希已从 bcrypt 迁移到 argon2。我将直接使用新路径。

<oai-mem-citation>
<citation_entries>
MEMORY.md:48-52|note=[auth module refactor — OAuth callback path change]
rollout_summaries/2026-03-15T14-22-00-7cF2-auth_module_refactor.md:10-14|note=[argon2 migration evidence]
</citation_entries>
<rollout_ids>
019c6e27-e55b-73d1-87d8-4e01f1f75043
</rollout_ids>
</oai-mem-citation>

annotation.zh: 模型使用了 MEMORY.md 和 rollout_summaries/ 中的记忆，在回复末尾附上 <oai-mem-citation> 块。citations.rs 解析后调用 record_stage1_output_usage()，usage_count+1，影响下次 Phase2 的选择排序。
annotation.en: Model used MEMORY.md and rollout_summaries/ memories, appended <oai-mem-citation> block at end of reply. citations.rs parses it and calls record_stage1_output_usage(), usage_count+1, affecting next Phase2 selection ordering.
